_help: Fills the starter template. extraction.py builds the schema, prompts and human-label template from this. issue_category is a constrained enum on purpose: it is where Phi's structured-output slips show up and is the target for the recovery experiment. Leave 'prompts' empty until you have seen the v1 errors, then add a 'v2_recovery' string that targets the failure Phi actually repeats.

issue_category.description: which of the four subtopic buckets this request falls into

request_type.description: the specific 311 issue named in the request, copied as written

responsible_department.description: the city department the request was routed to, or null if not stated

neighborhood.description: the Pittsburgh neighborhood named in the request, or null if not stated

entities.description: named organizations, places or facilities mentioned, copied exactly
